in_hebrew.name: זמני
in_hebrew.meaning: זמני - שייך לזמן, קשור לרגע או תקופה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זמני הוא שם שמקורו בעברית ופירושו 'שייך לזמן' או 'קשור לרגע או תקופה'. השם עשוי להיות קשור למושג הזמן כפי שהוא מוזכר בתנ"ך, שם הזמן נתפס כמתנה מאלוהים (תהלים קיט, קסא). השם עשוי גם להיות קשור למושג 'זמן' ביוונית, דרך המילה היוונית 'chronos' (χρόνος), שגם היא מתייחסת לזמן.

in_greek.name: Ζαμάνι
in_greek.meaning: Ζαμάνι - χρονικός, σχετικός με τον χρόνο
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζαμάνι είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'χρονικός' ή 'σχετικός με τον χρόνο'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο χρόνος θεωρείται δωροδοτούμενος από τον Θεό (Προφήτης, Ψαλμός 119: 161). Η λέξη 'χρόνος' (chronos) είναι σημαντική στην ελληνική γλώσσα και συνδέεται με την έννοια του χρόνου.

in_latin.name: Zamani
in_latin.long_meaning: Zamani est nomen quod significat 'temporalis' vel 'ad tempus pertinens'. In Ecclesia primitiva, tempus considerabatur donum a Deo datum (Psalmus 119: 161). Nomen 'Zamani' potest etiam connecti cum notione 'tempus' in lingua Latina, per verbum 'tempus', quod ipsum refertur ad durationem et momenta vitae.

in_english.name: Zamani
in_english.meaning: Zamani - related to time or moment
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zamani is derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying 'related to time or moment'. In the biblical context, time is considered a gift from God (Psalm 119: 161). The name Zamani may be associated with the concept of 'time' in Greek, through the word 'chronos' (χρόνος), which refers to time. This name reflects a deep spiritual significance, emphasizing the importance of time and moments in life. The personality traits associated with the name Zamani include a sense of punctuality, urgency, and appreciation for the present moment. In modern Christian cultures, the name Zamani is used across various denominations, symbolizing a connection to the divine timing and providence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zamani is of Swahili origin and is not commonly used among Christians in the English-speaking world. However, its usage is gaining popularity, particularly among communities with strong Swahili cultural influences or those who appreciate the beauty of African languages.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zamani holds deep spiritual significance, reminding us that we are not alone in our daily struggles and that God is always present with us. It also serves as a reminder of the promise of God's constant companionship, providing comfort and strength during difficult times. In essence, Zamani represents a connection to the Divine and a reminder of the presence of God in our lives.
